litigation.mdlName: In re: Aqueous Film-Forming Foams Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, District of South Carolina (Charleston)

phaseDetail: CMO 26O sets Group B case-selection and expert-discovery proposals for November 20, 2026. CMO 33F sets thyroid/liver-cancer Rule 702 responses for November 20, 2026 and replies for January 22, 2027; these are not trial dates. Separately, the water-system administrator lists four additional proposed C.A.A.N. settlements with preliminary approval and a January 15, 2027 final fairness hearing. Public orders and administrator pages were reviewed November 10, 2026.
defendants: Arkema, Chemguard, Buckeye Fire Equipment, National Foam, Dynax and others

settlements.label: 3M — public water systems
settlements.status: final approved, claims administration — water systems only
settlements.detail: $10.5 billion to $12.5 billion paid over 13 years to public water systems for PFAS contamination, per the official settlement FAQ. Final approval entered by Judge Gergel (fairness hearing February 2, 2024). Compensates water utilities, not individuals.
settlements.individualClaims: Public water systems only; this settlement does not resolve individual personal-injury claims.

settlements.label: DuPont / Chemours / Corteva — public water systems
settlements.status: final approved, claims administration — water systems only
settlements.detail: $1.185 billion settlement resolving claims of roughly 14,000 public water systems. Final approval entered following the December 14, 2023 fairness hearing.
settlements.individualClaims: Public water systems only; this settlement does not resolve individual personal-injury claims.

settlements.label: Tyco Fire Products / Chemguard — public water systems
settlements.status: final approved, claims administration — water systems only
settlements.detail: $750 million settlement; final approval order entered November 2024 (ECF 6406).
settlements.individualClaims: Public water systems only; this settlement does not resolve individual personal-injury claims.

settlements.label: BASF — public water systems
settlements.status: final approved, claims administration — water systems only
settlements.detail: $316.5 million total ($312.5M settlement amount + $4M notice/administration); agreement signed May 20, 2024, final approval entered November 22, 2024.
settlements.source: BASF preliminary approval motion (official settlement site)
settlements.individualClaims: Public water systems only; this settlement does not resolve individual personal-injury claims.

settlements.label: Carrier, Amerex, Archroma and Nation Ford — proposed public-water-system settlements
settlements.detail: The administrator lists four additional proposed water-system settlements with preliminary approval. Its C.A.A.N. schedule lists objections due November 23, 2026, exclusion requests due December 22, 2026, and a final fairness hearing on January 15, 2027. These are not individual personal-injury programs.
settlements.individualClaims: Eligible public-water-system claims only; no individual personal-injury payment program is announced by these proposals.

settlements.label: Personal-injury claims
settlements.detail: The official administrator lists four finally approved public-water-system settlements and four additional proposed C.A.A.N. water-system settlements with preliminary approval. These programs address public-water-system claims, not individual injury payments. Public MDL orders and the administrator website reviewed November 10, 2026 did not identify a global personal-injury settlement or an official individual payout schedule.
settlements.individualClaims: The official administrator lists four finally approved public-water-system settlements and four additional proposed C.A.A.N. water-system settlements with preliminary approval. These programs address public-water-system claims, not individual injury payments. Public MDL orders and the administrator website reviewed November 10, 2026 did not identify a global personal-injury settlement or an official individual payout schedule.
settlements.source: Public MDL orders and official water-system administrator

keyDates.label: C.A.A.N. water-system final fairness hearing
